title: Selling Your House in San Antonio in 2026: What It's Worth, How Long It Takes, What Changed
seo_title: Sell My House in San Antonio (2026): Price, Timeline & New Rules | Kanye Concierge 360
description: San Antonio homes now average 88 days on market and sell for 92.4% of original list price. Here's how to price right, what the 2026 Texas rules mean for sellers, and what to disclose.
keywords: how to sell a house in San Antonio
what is my home worth San Antonio
hero_alt: Selling a house in San Antonio
intro: The San Antonio market has shifted. Homes take longer to sell than a year ago, and buyers have more choices. That doesn't mean you can't sell well. It means pricing and preparation matter more than they have in years.

items: Median sale price: $302,999, down about 2% from a year ago
Days on market: 88 on average, up 11%
Months of inventory: 5.95
Pending sales: down 16% from a year ago
Price received: 92.4% of the original list price, on average

sections.h2: The 92.4% number is the whole story
paras: On average, homes are selling for about 7.6% less than their first asking price. That gap is the distance between where a home starts and where it finishes. Starting at the right price is how you keep it small.
items: $300,000 first asking price: a 7.6% gap is about $22,800
after: Those are illustrations of the September 2026 average, not a prediction for your home.

sections.h2: What changed for Texas sellers in 2026
items: Buyer agreements: since January 1, 2026, Texas law requires a written agreement before an agent shows a home or presents an offer
Commissions: the agreement must say compensation is not set by law and is fully negotiable
MLS: offers of buyer-agent pay are no longer posted on the MLS (NAR settlement, August 2024)
Disclosure form: TREC's Seller's Disclosure Notice was updated effective May 28, 2026
Flooding: whether the home is in a 100-year or 500-year floodplain, any past flooding, and flood insurance
Known defects: roof, foundation, plumbing, electrical and more
Tip: disclose honestly and early. Surprises found by a buyer's inspector are how deals fall apart

sections.h2: What helps a house sell in this market
items: Price: set from recent nearby sales, not from what you need
Repairs: fix the known problems before listing
Photos: professional, bright, every room
Roof and insurance: Texas insurers can no longer deny or drop a policy based only on roof or home age, which helps buyers of older homes
Flexibility: easy showings in the first two weeks, when interest is highest

faq.q: How long does it take to sell a house in San Antonio?
faq.a: Homes averaged 88 days on market in September 2026, up 11% from a year earlier (SABOR).

faq.q: What is my house worth in San Antonio?
faq.a: It depends on recent sales of similar homes near you. The metro median sale price was $302,999 in September 2026. Ask for a free, no-obligation price opinion based on your actual neighborhood.

faq.q: Are real estate commissions set by law in Texas?
faq.a: No. Since January 1, 2026, Texas buyer agreements must state that compensation is not set by law and is fully negotiable.
